# SGit API — static vault projection (sgit-ai.github.io/SGit-AI__API)

> This host is a pure static projection of the SGit API's documentation vault: the
> encrypted object store of vault `ivpijuvg`, served at the same paths as the live
> SG/Send API, plus one HTML page that decrypts and renders the docs in the browser.
> There is no server, no auth, and nothing but GETs. The host holds only ciphertext.

The repository behind this site: https://github.com/SGit-AI/SGit-AI__API (branch `dev`).
The plaintext of every document served here is committed there under `vault/` — if you
are an agent without a JS runtime, read the markdown straight from the repository:

- vault/docs/what-is-the-sgit-api.md — what the API is, what the server can/cannot see
- vault/docs/read-contract.md — the GET walk, the client-side derivations, cache semantics
- vault/docs/static-hosting.md — why this deployment is a conformance test; what breaks
- vault/docs/roadmap.md — done/next toward the sgit.ai/deploy objective
- vault/README.md — what the vault is and how it is published

## Reading the vault from this host (no repository needed)

Read key (published deliberately; grants read only):
  c28b118c9a7a101910efa24a3a49b6cc6dbec8e8dcdc8fea671e89cecb0ab817
Vault id: ivpijuvg

The walk — every step a plain GET of a computed path:
  ref file id = 'ref-pid-muw-' + hex(HMAC-SHA256(read_key, 'sg-vault-v1:file-id:ref:ivpijuvg'))[:12]
  GET /SGit-AI__API/api/vault/read/ivpijuvg/bare/refs/<ref-id>     -> AES-256-GCM(iv||ct), JSON {commit_id}
  GET .../bare/data/<commit-id>                                    -> commit {tree_id, parents, message_enc}
  GET .../bare/data/<tree-id>                                      -> tree {entries: [{blob_id, tree_id, name_enc, ...}]}
  GET .../bare/data/<blob-id>                                      -> a file's ciphertext
  all decryption with the read key; *_enc metadata fields are base64(iv||ct) of UTF-8.
A reference implementation in ~90 lines is served here as /SGit-AI__API/reader.js
(browser WebCrypto and Node >= 19).

## Known gap (pinned in CI)

The sgit CLI's `clone` cannot yet read from this host — it depends on the live API's
batch endpoint (POST /api/vault/batch/...). A proposal for GET-only static clone (which
would also make a local folder a valid remote) is filed at
team/comms/briefs/08/17/v0.1.2__proposal-brief__static-clone-a-get-is-open-a-file-and-a-folder-is-a-remote.md
in the repository. Writes and authentication are absent by design: this is a published,
read-only snapshot and the ciphertext is the protection.
